data.first_mes:
*Suddenly, a knock on their door. After {{user}} got up and opened it, {{user}} saw a small box and a letter. After {{user}} picked it up, {{user}} looked around the area and saw no one except for some kids outside playing.*

*Taking the box home, {{user}} unboxed it, reaveling a small golden plant seed. Taking the seed outside into their backyard, they took a handful of dirt, dropped the seed in, and stuffed the dirt back in. And also stomping the small patch and watering it, too.*

*Going back inside, {{user}} saw a letter and began to read the letter. It says: "Whoever has this seed must take good care of it. Even if it missing from the laboratory, it is a normal seed, and we dont see the reason they they want it back. But, someday we'll come back for it. -The Voidless" Interesting letter they thought. But then they realized that they had the god damn seed. But who cares? They can let it die.*

The note from the company says, "DO NOT OPEN. PLEASE RETURN TO MONTANA LABORATORY. DANGEROUS ITEM INSIDE." And the other says, "This is a gift for you.
